title: docs(adr): ADR-0145 amended — a ui-only tombstone's R is judged against the fixed group's @objectstack/spec@M.0.0 cut, and D1 names the ADR-0087 level-half amendment
body:
Fixes #27291
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:ADR-0145 两处条款各加一条修订注(照 ADR-0087 的修订拼法,原文保留在注里),状态行记为 Accepted(#27251 的合并)并加 Amended 条目。决定本身不变:ui 墓碑随 spec 的窗口退场,退休后一个 major,绝不更长;不删任何墓碑,不改代码、schema 或 changeset。
- **为什么改**:D2 的 ui-only 时钟原来读 `@object-ui/types` 自己的首个 release tag,而该包的 17 从 `17.1.0` 开始、没有 `17.0.0`,于是在 16.1.0 与 17.1.0 之间诞生的 ui-only 墓碑会被读成 R = 17(spec 时钟读 16),比 spec 多活一个 major —— 恰是 D1 禁止的。D1 引的「ADR-0087 2026-09-13 修订」有两段同日文本,现在点名 #18003 的 level-half 那一段。
- **风险与回滚**:只改 ADR 文本,不发布任何包;回滚 = revert 这一个 commit。误差方向:修订前偏长(不会提前删除),修订后与 spec 时钟一致。
- **先看**:`docs/adr/0145-ui-deprecation-tombstones-retire-on-the-spec-window.md` —— ① D2 的 ui-only 条目(新 L87–96,规则本身);② D1 的 level-axis 条目(新 L60–66,仅引文);③ 状态行(新 L3–6)。
- **两分钟验证**:`npm view @object-ui/types versions --json` 看到 `16.1.0` 之后直接是 `17.1.0`;`git ls-remote --tags origin '@objectstack/spec@17.0.0'` 返回一行 —— 修订针对的就是这两个事实。
- **需要你做的**:Tier H(`docs/adr/**`),PR 保持 draft;由 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 中的账号批准,或维护者亲手合并 / 入队。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0145-ui-deprecation-tombstones-retire-on-the-spec-window.md`, +17/−7 (167 → 177 lines). Two clauses are amended, each with an in-place `Amended 2026-10-28 (#27291)` note that quotes the former wording; the status entry records the acceptance and the amendment in ADR-0087's spelling. D1's window, D3, D4, D5 and the Applying-the-rule steps are untouched. Nothing is implemented: no tombstone is removed, no code, no schema, no changeset (`skip-changeset`: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing).

**Status line** — before:

```text
**Status**: Proposed (2026-10-28). `docs/adr/**` is Tier H (Prime Directive #14): this record becomes **Accepted** by
the maintainer's merge. **This record declares; it implements nothing** — …
```

after (PR #27251 merged 2026-10-28T14:43Z; `adr-index` keys the record by its earliest status keyword, so the row reads Accepted):

```text
**Status**: Accepted (2026-10-28, #27251) · **Amended** (2026-10-28, #27291 — one clause each; see the amendment notes
under D2's ui-only bullet and under D1's level-axis bullet). **This record declares; it implements nothing** — …
```

**D1, level-axis bullet (item 6 of triage's re-review, comment 6471216267 on PR #27251)** — before:

```text
(ADR-0087's 2026-09-13 amendment, `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`) and moves nothing here;
```

after:

```text
(ADR-0087's #18003 level-half amendment of 2026-09-13 — the note inside its "Ratified: the pre-launch launch-window
exemption" section — and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`) and moves nothing here;
> **Amended 2026-10-28 (#27291) — the citation names its text.** Was "ADR-0087's 2026-09-13 amendment": ADR-0087
> carries two texts of that date, the #12772 artifact-ingestion addendum being the other, and D1 means the level half.
```

**D2, ui-only bullet (item 5 of the same re-review)** — before:

```text
from the ui's own retirement. R is the major of the first `@object-ui/types` release tag (or the first release of the
package that publishes the `.d.ts`) whose tree carries the tombstone, on the same convention: first carried by a
major's `.0.0` cut counts in the major before it.
```

after:

```text
from the ui's own retirement, on the fixed group's clock (D1): R is read off the first `@objectstack/spec` release tag
whose tree carries the tombstone's introducing commit (for a commit the ui merge did not import, the first cut after
its date — step 2), on the convention the bullets above use: first carried by a major's `.0.0` cut counts in the major
before it. ⛔ Never off `@object-ui/types`' own tags: a major's first tag there need not be a `.0.0` cut.
> **Amended 2026-10-28 (#27291) — the ui-only clock reads the group's tags.** Was: "R is the major of the first
> `@object-ui/types` release tag (or the first release of the package that publishes the `.d.ts`) whose tree carries
> the tombstone, on the same convention: first carried by a major's `.0.0` cut counts in the major before it."
> `@object-ui/types` opens 17 at `17.1.0` (no `17.0.0`), so that reading gave a tombstone born before the
> `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` cut R = 17 where the spec's clock reads 16: one major longer, which D1 forbids.
```

The clause is one rule, not a two-branch fallback: because the group releases in lockstep (D1), reading the group's `@objectstack/spec` tags gives the same R as the ui package's own tags wherever those coincide, and the spec's R wherever the ui package skipped a `.0.0`. It points at D1 and at Applying-the-rule step 2 (`git tag --contains` on the introducing commit, the pre-merge objectui era dated on a full clone) rather than restating them.

**Worked examples (the test the order set; they live here, not in the ADR):**

- (a) A ui-only tombstone introduced between `@object-ui/types@16.1.0` and `17.1.0`, before the `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` cut. Old reading: first `@object-ui/types` tag carrying it is `17.1.0`, not a `.0.0` cut, so R = 17 — carried through 18, due at 19. New reading: the first `@objectstack/spec` tag carrying it is `17.0.0`, a `.0.0` cut, which counts in the major before, so R = 16 — carried through 17, due at the 18 cut, exactly the spec's own answer for a key refused from `17.0.0`.
- (b) A tombstone first carried by a 17.x release after the `17.0.0` cut. Both readings: first tag carrying it is `17.x` (x ≥ 1), so R = 17 — carried through 18, due at 19. The amendment moves nothing here.
- (c) A tombstone introduced today, after the `18.0.0` cut: first carrying tag `18.x`, R = 18, due at 20 — unchanged.

Registry facts the amendment rests on, re-read this run: `npm view @object-ui/types versions --json` lists `… 15.0.0, 16.0.0, 16.1.0, 17.1.0, 17.2.0, 17.3.0, 17.5.0, 17.6.0, 17.7.0, 18.0.0, 18.1.0, 18.2.0` (no `17.0.0`); `git ls-remote --tags origin '@objectstack/spec@17.0.0'` answers `100d9059…`.

## Tests

## Acceptance notes

- **`docs/adr/README.md` (the generated index) is not regenerated here.** `pnpm check:adr-index` is report-only by design and it already warned `stale` on `origin/main` `1c5fe3cb` before this edit: a regen on the clean tree moves ADR-0035's row (amended by #27069 without an index run). On this head a regen would move that row plus the 0145 row and the Accepted/Proposed counts (127/4). Scope here is the one ADR file; the next `pnpm adr:index` run refreshes both rows. Noted, not filed.
- PR #27251's `merged_by` reads `os-zhuang` through REST (`merged_at` 2026-10-28T14:43:02Z, merge commit `e9c88f7c`); the status entry records the PR number and date only.
- `check:role-word` was not derived for this diff — its roots are `content/docs` and `skills/`, not `docs/adr/` — so the order's gate-list hypothesis overstated the set by that one family; the other named families were all derived.
- Two added lines run 121–122 characters; the file already carried a 125-character line (former L5) and no gate reads line length under `docs/adr/`.
- The derived gate `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (unbuilt `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint`) — nothing measured; the two packages were built under `os-verify-lock.sh` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, held 86s, waited 0s) and the gate rerun exit 0.
